name: Arch Updates
author: Hadrien Boutteville
description: Repository, AUR, Flatpak and mise update status for Arch Linux and Arch-based systems such as CachyOS. Checks contact your package mirrors, the AUR, Flatpak remotes and mise's sources. Updates run in your terminal with Arch-Update / Cachy-Update, or directly with your AUR helper or sudo pacman.
